task_spec.prompt:
Implement knapsack(capacity, weights, values) in src/knapsack.py using bottom-up DP:
- Create dp table: dp[i][w] = max value using first i items with weight capacity w
- dp[0][w] = 0 for all w
- For each item i (1-indexed): if weights[i-1] <= w, dp[i][w] = max(dp[i-1][w], dp[i-1][w-weights[i-1]] + values[i-1]); else dp[i][w] = dp[i-1][w]
- Return dp[n][capacity]
